nodes.description: Pumpametti.paused - boolean kill switch checked at the start of mint().
Pumpametti.cost - price per token (0.01 ether) used to compute the required msg.value.
Pumpametti.maxXIA - hard cap of 300 tokens enforced in mint().
Pumpametti.maxMintAmount - maximum 10 tokens per transaction enforced in mint().
Pumpametti.baseURI - IPFS base URI returned by _baseURI() and consumed by tokenURI().
Pumpametti.baseExtension - '.json' suffix appended to the token URI.
WithLimitedSupply._maxSupply - maximum supply tracked by the token counter base contract.
WithLimitedSupply._tokenCount - Counters.Counter holding the number of minted tokens.
RandomlyAssigned.tokenMatrix - mapping used for the swap-and-pop random token id assignment.
Pumpametti.mint(uint256) payable - validates paused/amount/cap/payment then loops calling nextToken() and _safeMint().
Pumpametti.withdraw() - onlyOwner function sending the whole balance to msg.sender via low-level send().
Pumpametti.tokenURI(uint256) - builds the metadata URI from baseURI, tokenId and baseExtension.
Pumpametti.walletOfOwner(address) - view helper enumerating the token ids owned by an address.
Pumpametti._baseURI() - internal override returning the baseURI state variable.
Pumpametti constructor - initializes ERC721 metadata and RandomlyAssigned(300,1) token allocation.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken() - derives a pseudo-random index from block values (including block.timestamp) and returns the assigned token id.
ERC721._safeMint(address,uint256) - mints and invokes the receiver callback on contract recipients.
ERC721._mint(address,uint256) - core minting routine updating _balances and _owners.
ERC721._checkOnERC721Received() - external call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
WithLimitedSupply.availableTokenCount() - maxSupply() - tokenCount(), used by the availability modifiers.
WithLimitedSupply.maxSupply() - getter for _maxSupply.
WithLimitedSupply.tokenCount() - getter for the current Counter value.
Context._msgSender() - returns msg.sender, used as the mint recipient in mint().
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier - restricts withdraw() to the contract owner.
msg.sender as used by mint() - attacker controlled address that becomes the mint recipient and the reentrancy entry point.
block.timestamp as used in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken() - miner/validator influenceable value feeding the pseudo-random draw.
msg.sender as used by withdraw() - external destination of the balance transfer, guarded by onlyOwner.
_safeMint() inside the mint() loop - performs an external call to the recipient contract before the loop/final state settles, a reentrancy sink.
payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance) in withdraw() - unchecked-return, gas-limited low-level value transfer.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp)) - weak randomness/timestamp dependency controlling token id assignment.
cost * _mintAmount payment requirement in mint() - arithmetic expression that must stay consistent with the token cap.
mint(uint256 _mintAmount) - number of tokens requested by the caller.
walletOfOwner(address _owner) - address whose token ids are enumerated.
tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) - token id whose metadata URI is resolved.
Loop counter i inside mint().
mintIndex - token id returned by nextToken() inside the mint() loop.
ownerTokenCount - balanceOf(_owner) result in walletOfOwner().
tokenIds - memory array of owned token ids returned by walletOfOwner().
currentBaseURI - cached _baseURI() value in tokenURI().
random - pseudo-random index derived from block values in nextToken().
value - token id selected through the tokenMatrix swap logic in nextToken().
maxIndex - remaining supply used as the modulo bound in nextToken().
ensureAvailabilityFor(uint256 amount) - requested quantity compared against availableTokenCount().
token - cached Counter value returned by the base WithLimitedSupply.nextToken().

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside mint() via _msgSender() to determine the recipient of the newly minted token.
The attacker controlled msg.sender is forwarded as the 'to' argument of _safeMint(), making the caller the arbitrary contract that will be called back.
mint() unconditionally calls _safeMint() inside its loop before finishing its own accounting, leaving the transfer path re-entrant.
_safeMint() invokes _checkOnERC721Received(), which performs the external onERC721Received callback into the recipient contract.
The onERC721Received callback re-enters the contract execution context while mint() is still looping, allowing repeated mint attempts.
block.timestamp is packed into the keccak256 preimage that produces the pseudo-random token index.
The pseudo-random value derived from miner/validator influenceable block data determines the token id returned by nextToken().
mint() calls nextToken() on every loop iteration to obtain the next token id.
msg.sender is the destination of the balance transfer in withdraw(), gated only by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw() executes the low-level send() of the whole contract balance to the owner.
The onlyOwner modifier guards withdraw() so only the owner can drain the balance.
mint() requires paused to be false before any minting can occur.
mint() enforces _mintAmount <= maxMintAmount to bound per-transaction minting.
maxXIA is compared against totalSupply() + _mintAmount, the cap arithmetic that the payment check must match.
cost is multiplied by _mintAmount to compute the required payment value.
The cost * _mintAmount expression gates mint() through require(msg.value >= ...).
ensureAvailabilityFor(amount) compares the requested amount against availableTokenCount() through inequality arithmetic.
maxSupply() returns the _maxSupply state variable.
availableTokenCount() subtracts tokenCount() from maxSupply().
tokenCount() returns the current Counter value _tokenCount.
tokenCount() is subtracted from maxSupply() inside availableTokenCount().
nextToken() reads and writes tokenMatrix to perform the random swap-and-pop assignment.
_baseURI() returns the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI() calls _baseURI() to build the returned metadata string.
baseExtension is appended to the token URI by tokenURI().
The tokenId parameter selects the token whose URI is built and stringified.
The _owner parameter drives balanceOf() and tokenOfOwnerByIndex() in walletOfOwner().
The _mintAmount parameter controls the loop bound and all mint() validations.
Loop counter i drives the mint() iteration over requested tokens.
mintIndex holds the nextToken() result that is passed to _safeMint() inside mint().
ownerTokenCount sizes the returned array in walletOfOwner().
tokenIds is the array populated and returned by walletOfOwner().
currentBaseURI caches the _baseURI() result inside tokenURI().
The pseudo-random index random is derived from block data and selects the token id in nextToken().
value holds the matrix-resolved token index returned by nextToken().
maxIndex bounds the modulo operation and the swap logic in nextToken().
token caches the Counter value incremented by the base nextToken() implementation.
mint() obtains the caller address through _msgSender(), which simply returns msg.sender.
_msgSender() directly returns the untrusted msg.sender global.
_safeMint() performs the actual minting through the internal _mint() call before the receiver check.
_safeMint() requires the receiver check performed by _checkOnERC721Received().
mint() calls _safeMint() inside its loop, the path that leads to the external receiver callback.
withdraw() uses msg.sender as the recipient of the balance send() operation.

normalization_plan.reason: The _mintAmount parameter only exists to bound and drive the mint() loop and its validations.
The _owner parameter is used exclusively by walletOfOwner() for balance and enumeration lookups.
The tokenId parameter is consumed only by tokenURI() to build the metadata string.
The loop counter i is a transient mint() iteration variable with no independent semantics.
mintIndex is the locally scoped result of nextToken() used immediately by mint() when calling _safeMint().
ownerTokenCount is a temporary size value computed and consumed entirely inside walletOfOwner().
tokenIds is the return buffer populated only within walletOfOwner().
currentBaseURI is a cached value used only inside tokenURI() for string concatenation.
random is the pseudo-random index computed and consumed only within RandomlyAssigned.nextToken().
value is the locally resolved token id returned by nextToken() and has no meaning outside it.
maxIndex is a scoped modulo bound used only inside nextToken().
The amount parameter is compared directly against availableTokenCount() by the ensureAvailabilityFor modifier.
token caches the Counter value that nextToken() increments and returns.
